covered.rule: 1. Start exactly: "Good day, this is Larkspur Business Bank's automated assistant. We record this call."
1. Ask exactly: "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"
1. Ask at most twice in total; if still unclear close lark_unreached / lark_unclear
1. never say: arrears, overdue, facility, payment
2. Callbacks next business day only, 08:30-16:15 inclusive, strictly after now
2. invalid slot ask once; second failure closes lark_unreached / lark_no_callback
2. scheduled callback closes lark_unreached / lark_callback
2. Wrong number lark_unreached / lark_wrong_number
2. Deceased: "Please accept our condolences." lark_unreached / lark_deceased
3. Four questions in order postcode, birth_year, company_number, founded_year with formats
3. Maximum wrong answers 4; use checks_left
3. On exhaustion say "Please contact our business desk." close lark_unverified / lark_failed
3. Explain once; second refusal lark_unverified / lark_declined; why-question not a refusal
3. No recoverable-format hint
4. Up to 2 products
4. Name types: working capital line / asset finance loan / merchant advance
4. State all products before asking anything
4. "Next Friday" = following calendar week; missing month/year next occurrence
5. Days late 1-45: end_of_month basis=business adjustment=preceding
5. One persuasion attempt: full on deadline, floor if full refused
5. "Can you settle all these products today?" / "Can you settle this today?"
5. Separate attempt counters; exhaustion lark_refused; common date clamped
6. Floors by kind
6. Full first; floor once; "The remainder stays overdue."; never ask how much; accept between floor and full
6. Date may be today; roll forward within deadline; vague ask once then deadline
7. Batch read-back, "May I record these promises?"
7. One create_promise per product; retry once; second failure lark_service_error
7. "We will email confirmation to your registered address."
7. "Please contact our business desk to change a recorded promise."
8. Already paid: sentence, no promise, lark_settled, continue
8. Dispute: mark lark_disputed and continue
8. Hardship: sympathy, offer lark_care, else lark_distress and continue
8. Restructure: transfer lark_restructure, lark_transferred / lark_restructure
8. Human: ask once, transfer lark_desk, lark_transferred / lark_person
8. Refusal to talk: ask once; second refusal ends call, remaining lark_refused
8. Robot / scam / cannot-answer sentences
9. One note per unpromised product with listed reasons; no notes on transfer
9. Transfer keeps recorded promises
9. Outcome precedence
9. Thank and say goodbye before close_call
9. Debt intro "I am calling about the overdue business products."
10. Outcome code table

unresolved: No band/deadline is defined for products more than 45 days late (only 1-45 inclusive).
The hardship sympathy sentence is not dictated word for word (only 'one short sentence of sympathy'); 'I am sorry to hear that.' is a content-only rendering.
Holder confirmation detail ('Hello or a question does not confirm') and 'never offer a discount, waiver or new instalment plan' have no dedicated IR field; they are left to prompt text.
